title: Tuesday standup for the mobile team
summary: The team reviewed the login bug, confirming it was fixed and merged. Sam committed to updating the release notes by tomorrow noon. Dana reported that the payments integration is blocked awaiting sandbox keys from the bank and will email the bank again today. The group agreed to escalate to the account manager if the keys are not received by Thursday. The meeting concluded with a reminder of the next standup tomorrow.
discussion_points: Login bug has been fixed and merged
Release notes need to be updated
Payments integration is blocked awaiting sandbox keys from the bank
Dana will email the bank again today
Escalation plan if keys are not received by Thursday
decisions: Escalate to the account manager if sandbox keys are not received by Thursday
